verdict.rationale: Wrike is a work-management and project-planning platform, so AI-driven code-diff review is outside its product category. Its AI features (content editing, comment summaries, Copilot work summaries, custom agents for triage and risk) and its GitHub two-way sync concern tasks and projects, not analysing code changes. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships diff-sectioning or code-change explanation, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
